title: TrueLine v2 Redline Manifest
description: Engine->website contract (Phase 1). The website consumes ONLY this manifest for drawn/covered/blocked truth -- never parent_source_model.json, never PNG filenames. Each schema_version is pinned by this file. Keyword usage is intentionally a small subset (type, enum, const, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, minItems, minimum) so it can be validated with or without a JSON-Schema library.

schema_version.description: Pins the contract version this file describes.

mock_example.description: true => hand-authored example, not produced by the solver/renderer. A real engine manifest sets this false.

disclaimer.description: Human-readable provenance / honesty statement for this manifest instance.

render_commit.description: Last commit that changed the drawn set.

generated_from.description: How this manifest was produced (runner id / 'hand-authored ...').

bundle_origin.description: Optional origin tier. HUMAN_CONFIRMED_SOURCE_ANCHOR marks a bundle drawn from human-confirmed source-anchor control points (NOT solver/renderer output, NOT counted in the deterministic frontier). DETERMINISTIC_RECOGNIZED_CORPUS marks a job-local bundle that serves the EXISTING deterministic engine render for a POSITIVELY-recognized known corpus (engine-derived, NOT human-clicked; a separate job-local bundle, NOT re-counted in the committed deterministic frontier). UPLOADED_CORPUS_ENGINE marks a job-local bundle produced by RUNNING the engine on a job's own uploaded plan + reviewed bore-log (engine-derived from the plan's drawn geometry; a separate job-local bundle, NOT re-counted in the committed deterministic frontier). Absent on legacy / deterministic-engine manifests (which are DETERMINISTIC_ENGINE by default).

frontier.description: Headline 'drawn/total' string, e.g. '50/58'. Never display total/total.

consumption_rules.description: Plain-language rules the consuming website/backend must honor.

drawn_lane.description: Authoritative drawn mechanism: prior render lane vs current callout-route-assembly sweep; null when not drawn.

source_sheets.description: Drawn-truth sheet numbers (owner-corrected where applicable; see warnings).

closure.description: Drawn-length closure figures. null when not captured for this entry (this mock fills it only where a published figure exists).

covered_by.description: log_id whose existing stroke already places this bore's route.

coverage.description: Parent/child or duplicate coverage relationships. null when none.

unlock_requirement.description: The named source/owner input that would unblock this log.

kind.description: Only FINAL_REDLINE_PNG is a redline output the website renders.

path.description: Manifest-relative published path (relative to the manifest's own directory once published).

sha256.description: Content hash; null on a placeholder, a 64-char hex digest once published.

example_placeholder.description: true => mock path, not a real published artifact; false once published.

bytes.description: Published artifact size in bytes. Absent on placeholder entries; set by the artifact publisher.

published.description: true once copied to the stable publish directory with a real sha256. Absent/false on placeholders.

artifacts.description: Empty for non-drawn logs. Website renders only kind == FINAL_REDLINE_PNG, addressed by path + sha256. Placeholder entries (example) omit bytes/published; the publisher fills path/sha256/bytes/published and flips example_placeholder to false.

ref.description: Repo-relative path to the supporting source-of-truth.

warnings.description: Consumer-facing hazards (e.g. stale fixture fields, owner-corrected sheets).

state.description: REVIEW placement-candidate lifecycle state. The manifest is published at render time so it records CANDIDATE; the live accept/reject decision lives in the review-acceptance record and is overlaid by the export/closeout reader.

confidence.description: Graded REVIEW confidence band (null on a named-dialect candidate that carries no graded signals).

confidence_score.description: 0..1 confidence (capped below 1.0 -- a REVIEW candidate is NEVER AUTO). null when ungraded.

warnings.description: Honest hazards (low confidence, many rival runs, noisy axis, short extent).

dialect.description: Dialect that produced the candidate ('generic' for the name-free fallback).

generic_fallback.description: true => placed by the name-free generic-geometry fallback (no recognized convention).

placement_candidate.description: Present (non-null) ONLY on bundle_origin UPLOADED_CORPUS_ENGINE manifests: the REVIEW placement-candidate state + graded confidence + reasons/warnings for a general uploaded-project placement. ABSENT on deterministic/recognized manifests (which are FINAL drawn truth, never review candidates), so those stay byte-identical.

station_dots.description: Present ONLY on bundle_origin HUMAN_CONFIRMED_SOURCE_ANCHOR manifests: interval/footage dots along the human-confirmed redline (every 50' by default plus the final endpoint), each clickable and carrying that bore's log info. ABSENT on deterministic/recognized/uploaded manifests (which never emit it), so those stay byte-identical. Never AUTO and never part of the deterministic frontier.

footage_along.description: Feet from the redline start (self-calibrated from the reviewed row footage / drawn length).

station.description: The dot's station label: the bore log's OWN recorded station text for a SOURCE_RECORDED dot, or start_station + footage_along for a DERIVED_INTERVAL dot (only when the start station parses); else null (footage_along still present).

xy_display.description: Dot position in the plan page's PDF display space (the renderer's stroke space).

origin.description: Station-dot contract (Mission 8 addendum): SOURCE_RECORDED == an actual reading/endpoint the bore log recorded; DERIVED_INTERVAL == an interior 50'-tick this module derived (permitted only when the log records just start/end/total footage), NEVER presented as recorded. REQUIRED on every dot.

station_evidence.description: Present ONLY on a SOURCE_RECORDED dot whose station came from a graded reading cell (station-readings series): the cell's raw verbatim text + read status + confidence. Absent on a DERIVED_INTERVAL dot (it carries no cell evidence to point to) and on a SOURCE_RECORDED span-endpoint dot with no per-station cell (a generic TABLE_IMPORT row's recorded start/end).

station_marks_basis.description: Station-dot contract (Mission 8 addendum, contracts/station_marks.py): the evidence basis this anchor's station_dots were built on -- STATION_SERIES (>2 recorded readings, no fill), SERIES_ENDPOINTS_WITH_DERIVED_FILL (2 recorded readings + tagged interior fill), or SPAN_ENDPOINTS (no usable recorded series; the approved span's own endpoints + tagged fill). null when this anchor carries no dots at all (no footage/row). Present ONLY on bundle_origin HUMAN_CONFIRMED_SOURCE_ANCHOR manifests.

station_marks_warnings.description: Station-dot contract (Mission 8 addendum): named codes (e.g. STATION_SERIES_ENDPOINT_MISMATCH) explaining why a recorded station series existed but was rejected as unusable and the dots fell through to SPAN_ENDPOINTS. Empty when no such rejection occurred (including when the row simply never had a series).

geometry_basis.description: Phase-2 source-route adoption (T31 Q5) + Mission 8 manual-route. Present ONLY on an EXPLICITLY-CONFIRMED v2 source-anchor log entry: OBSERVER_BACKBONE_HUMAN_ADOPTED identifies a server-verified, human-adopted observer-backbone route (paired with a route_adoption block); HUMAN_CLICKED_POLYLINE identifies an operator-confirmed manual N-point polyline or representative straight segment (paired with a manual_route block). ABSENT on a plain (pre-Mission-8) HUMAN_CONFIRMED_SOURCE_ANCHOR v1 log -- so every prior manifest stays byte-identical.

confirmation_state.description: Present ONLY alongside geometry_basis: the explicit human-confirmation state for an adopted route (distinct from, and never overriding, the log's own status/provenance enums above).

render_control_points.description: Present ONLY alongside geometry_basis: the server-derived N-point RENDER polyline actually drawn (human start + the clipped observer backbone + human end) -- the same points as the source_anchor record's control_points, carried here for a manifest-only consumer.

route_adoption.description: Present (non-null) ONLY alongside geometry_basis == OBSERVER_BACKBONE_HUMAN_ADOPTED: the source-route adoption provenance block (source sheet/page, span/row identity, exact human clicks, connectivity rationale, warnings, both hashes) -- NEVER describes the interior observer-backbone vertices as human-clicked. ABSENT (not null) on every non-adopted log, and NEVER co-present with manual_route on the same log (mutually exclusive provenance).

reported_route_search.description: Client-attested (NEVER server-re-verified) route-search refusal the operator's session received before confirming this manual/representative route -- honestly named 'reported_'.

manual_route.description: Present (non-null) ONLY alongside geometry_basis == HUMAN_CLICKED_POLYLINE: the Mission-8 manual-route provenance block (representative status, the exact human control points split start/end/intermediate, the reported route-search refusal if any, confirming session + timestamp). ABSENT (not null) on every non-manual log, and NEVER co-present with route_adoption on the same log (mutually exclusive provenance).
